hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|/dist/)' && echo "Blocked: do not edit $FILE" && exit 2 || exit 0
